newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Carpenter,Ramsgate jump on Mt Kare result.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter,Ramsgate jump on Mt Kare result.

text.p: The shares of Carpenter Pacific Resources NL and Ramsgate Resources NL rose sharply in early trade on Monday after the release of promising drill results from the Mt Kare gold project in Papua New Guinea.
At 10.20 a.m (0020 GMT), Carpenter shares were 16 cents higher at 54 cents while Ramsgate shares were up three cents at 12.5 cents.
Both companies saw their share prices rise sharply on Friday after the report from Carpenter which confirmed that the deposit was similar to the nearby Porgera gold mine.
Carpenter said assay results showed gold of up to a massive 2,140.98 grams per tonne (g/t) and as low as 0.62 g/t.
Ramsgate through its 73.2 percent owned subsidiary, Oakland Pty Ltd, owns one third of Carpenter Pacific and its subsidiary Matu Mining Pty Ltd.

Matu Mining holds exploration licence (EL) 1093 at Mt Kare. Carpenter's joint venture partnet at EL1093 is Canadian group, Madison Enterprises Corp. Madison is entitled to 65 percent of the Mt Kare project upon the expenditure of A$10 million.
